public_intro: Publish a copy of your profile on {domain}, readable by anyone with its address. It stays off until you turn it on.
public_how: Your instance sends the copy, then every change, to the Selfboxd platform. The platform never connects to your instance and never learns its address. The copy holds what your profile shows: banner, picture, username, bio, favorites, pinned reviews, diary, reviews, watchlist, likes, tags and lists. Nothing about your machine or your instance.
public_handle_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, 2 to 30 characters.
public_code_hint: Four digits. Visitors must enter it to see the profile, and its RSS feed gets a secret address.
public_restore_hint: Moved to a new instance? Paste the recovery key of your profile to take it back.
public_pending: Changes wait to be sent; they will be sent as soon as the platform can be reached.
public_code_off: Anyone with the address can see your profile.
public_recovery_hint: Keep it somewhere safe: it is the only way to take your profile to another instance, and anyone holding it can change your profile.
public_rotate_hint: Creates a new key pair for your profile. The current recovery key stops working.
public_rotated: The key has been changed. Copy the new recovery key.
public_delete_hint: Removes the copy from the platform. Your instance keeps everything.
